race.title: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Unpenalised for his decisive Fontwell success, MARHABA PRINCE looks the percentage call in a race where several have a chance. Sheezer Diva gets the nod over Rip Wheeler for next best, with Ventara potentially interesting if supported for a bang-in-form stable. MARHABA PRINCE SHEEZER DIVA (IRE) RIP WHEELER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sheezer Diva (2/1), Marhaba Prince (9/4), Rip Wheeler (10/3), Ventara (12/1), Rock On Cowboy (14/1), Moon Monarch (14/1), Longmoor (20/1), Following Chapter (20/1), Galactique (25/1)
